During the [[Imperial Civil War]], [[High Admiral]] [[Treuten Teradoc]] of the [[Greater Maldrood]], established his personal [[Fortress/Legends|headquarters]] within an [[asteroid field]]. It was built into the biggest [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]]. In it, Teradoc was capable of [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanding]] his [[Crimson Command|forces]].
